projects.title: E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A scalable e-commerce storefront with cart, checkout, and order management.

architecture: React SPA frontend with server-side rendering for SEO.
REST API backend split into product, cart, checkout, and order services.
PostgreSQL for transactional data, Redis for cart sessions and caching.
Message queue for order processing and inventory updates.
features: Product catalog with search and faceted filtering.
Cart and checkout flow with payment gateway integration.
Admin dashboard for inventory and pricing.
challenges: Keeping cart and inventory consistent under concurrent load.
Reducing checkout latency through caching and eager payments.
accomplishments: Handled 10x peak traffic with no downtime.
Reduced checkout time by 40% through caching.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: A real-time messaging platform with presence, typing indicators, and group rooms.

architecture: Redis pub/sub for horizontal fan-out across gateway instances.
MongoDB for message persistence with TTL indexes.
Presence and typing indicators driven by ephemeral Redis state.
challenges: Scaling WebSocket connections across multiple instances.
accomplishments: Delivered messages with p99 latency under 200ms.
